For closedness, verified that when \(u+v>0\) the rectangle \([u,u+\varepsilon)\times[v,v+\varepsilon)\) has minimum sum \(u+v>0\); when \(u+v<0\) choosing \(\delta_1,\delta_2\) with \(\delta_1+\delta_2<-(u+v)\) makes the rectangle lie in \(\{x+y<0\}\). The case \(u+v=0\) is excluded (it is \(D\)). The discrete argument uses \([x,x+1)\times[-x,-x+1)\), which is non‑empty and isolates \((x,-x)\). No counterexample or boundary failure was found.
